We recall the graph of $y={(\frac{1}{4})}^{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13943873/assets/2a24c00ab4fbb960e93278c340bd4b1368f28e7d521d415a2e7a4868d2f58064.png)

From the graph, we see that the function decreases to zero as $x$ increases. Therefore,

$$
{lim}_{x\to \infty }{(\frac{1}{4})}^{x}=0.
$$
